sink.description: The writer this process records through.

tokenFile.description: A file holding the token presented to the writer, read afresh on every request: in a cluster, the pod's projected service-account token. Unset presents none, which an anonymous trial install accepts.

description: The configuration of `audit verify --config`, which walks digest chains and reports what it finds. Secrets are never in this file: a field named ...Env holds the NAME of the environment variable that holds the secret. Telemetry is the OTEL_* environment, not configuration.

archive.description: Where the archive is and how it is written.

lockMode.description: The Object Lock mode every object is written in: compliance (the record tier), governance (a lock a privileged role can shorten), or none (the attested tier, for a store without Object Lock). A process refuses to start when a profile demands a stricter mode than this.

prefix.description: The prefix within the bucket. Required in a bucket shared with other installations: it is what keeps two of them apart.

deployment.description: Path to the profile configuration; the check holds each object's lock to what its profile demands.

last.description: Check the windows of the last this long, ending at the hour that has closed.

lookback.description: How far before the range to look for objects keyed under an older day; at least what the digest job used.

profiles.description: The profiles whose chains to walk. Unset walks every profile the deployment composes.

publicKeyFile.description: The PEM public key the digests were signed with.

record.description: Write a verification per window into the archive under verified/, which a record's provenance reads. Needs write access there.

sink.description: The writer this job records what it checked through.

title: audit verify
